name: Amagi Touya
source:
Head of the Amagi Family, Gosanke of the Youkai Extermination House. Specializes in the art of using familiars. Serious and full of justice, but a bit clumsy.

The main character of another work "REACT", now a 21-year-old fourth-year university student.
Since 5 years ago, he seems to have honed his sword skills a little.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/ikiru-character?pgid=l3smunhx-761cc200-f6cb-42bf-a3cb-ba29c213a4a1]official website[/url]]
